'''Loren Morrick''' was the head of the medbay on [[Arda Base]]. She was in her late thirties, and was worn down by the war. She had lost many friends and colleagues in battle, but she kept fighting for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] because she believed in the Alliance's cause.<ref name="OAA1" />

==History==
[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] Morrick helped tend to the wounded [[Soldier/Legends|Soldiers]] throughout the [[Ardan resistance|Ardan Resistance's]] adventures throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer]] and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] territories.<ref name="OAA1" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1st}}
